scope: Pre-execution source and mathematical review of the frozen eight-case fabricated translation/layout qualification. Integration and target measurement are excluded.

findings.polynomial_translation: For d_old=d_new+s, the 20 quadratic,16 linear,constant basis is closed under translation. Its feature transform is upper triangular. Each row constant is updated before its original linear coefficients; each linear update depends only on its unchanged quadratic entries and its own old linear entry. This computes R*T without another factor.
findings.failure_policy: All source entries, shifts and prospective coefficient sums are checked before writes. Argument/alias/nonfinite preflight rejection preserves the factor. A mutation-stage fault explicitly requires the owner to latch unavailable; rollback is not promised.
findings.finite_qualification: Eight fixed cases include 255 independent dense long-double cost/full-gradient/full-Hessian comparisons, all37 basis terms and all20 pair identities, inverse/composition, rejection and complete layout assertions. Frozen tolerance covers these computed bounded fixtures; no physical or posterior threshold.
findings.ownership: Primitive does not read observations, evaluate a model or prior, change source/cursor ownership or relinearize old nonlinear evidence. Boundary-jet transport is separate and not implemented here.
findings.runner: One exclusive attempt, one build and at most one test; source hashes checked after, test output committed through existing capture-preservation utility before JSON use. Host cumulative-child RSS and per-function compiler frames are labeled, not target SRAM measurements.

layout_requirements: The standalone adc12_stream is not additionally live. Source identity and committed cursor are reused from bank.
Actual sizeof and offsets must pass the frozen fixture. ss_input and all integration temporaries must occupy counted stack/result storage.
Query view is packed1088+gradient128+point128+state224+decoded32=1600. Merge view376+296+32+24=728 overlays it.
Calibration and tick conversion must be immutable within the evidence generation or require explicit invalidation/versioning.
Complete integrated stack, target ABI, IRQ/DMA concurrency and timing remain unqualified. The planned reserve is not a measured deployment fit.
